notes: Knowledge retrieval coverage, kept apart from the four safety suites: every case here runs the real retrieveForTurn against a match arm and is scored on ranking, never on a draft.

The entries are the 46 real Prospect FAQ Sheet / FAQs question strings (the Inbound Message column) as captured in 2026-09, verbatim after the importer's trim, including the curly quotes some rows carry. The fake arm embeds them itself; the live arm resolves each question to the published snapshot row with the same inbound_message and reports a case unresolvable when the snapshot does not carry it, so a re-import that edits an Inbound Message must be mirrored here or its cases stop resolving.

Response templates carry the real answers with placeholders normalised the way the importer registers them ({{niche}}, {{target_funding_amount}}, {{booking_link}}, asset.* for the course and clinic links) and with nothing personally identifying kept; the offer fixture supplies every slot they need so no entry is dropped at render time.

Lead messages paraphrase the row they expect across all six categories (General Questions, Credit, Business, Program/Service, Application/Booking, Funding Qs) and never copy the question string, so the suite measures paraphrase retrieval and not string equality.
noMatch cases are off-topic, other-industry or gibberish. They are the only source of the no-match precision figure, so keep at least six.

offer.qualificationSummary: a credit score in the coach's working range and a funding goal inside the program's band

entries.question: No $ but good credit
entries.responseTemplate: Based on your credit we may still be able to help. I’m happy to go over some options if you are available for a 30 min call this week?

entries.question: Not sure if lead needs help with funding
entries.responseTemplate: I think I’m confused. Do you need our help with funding?

entries.question: Not ready yet
entries.responseTemplate: Sounds like you're on track! Remember, when you're ready to move forward or if you have any inquiries, don't hesitate to reach out. Feel free to contact me when ready, and I'll be more than happy to assist you.

entries.question: Where are you based? / Where do you live?
entries.responseTemplate: I'm based in Florida. And you?

entries.question: How long have you been running this company?
entries.responseTemplate: I've been in this industry for the past 5 years and running this particular company for 3 years now

entries.question: Free courses
entries.responseTemplate: Checkout this link and access my free course. It'll help you learn more about funding, how to prepare for it, and the steps to get you on track. And it's completely free.  Here is the link for that: {{asset.free-course}}

entries.question: How do I know you aren't scammers?
entries.responseTemplate: I pride myself on being the face of the company and being very public with our results and what we do. You can also checkout the many testimonials and screenshots on my website or the content on my Youtube

entries.question: No money
entries.responseTemplate: Unfortunately we do charge high ticket for our service. Our goal is to help you get funding so that you can {{dream_outcome}}. If you think that you would benefit from getting access to an extra 50-150k from the banks let me know!

entries.question: Does the business need to make a monthly minimum?
entries.responseTemplate: An established business is ideal but we do help clients with brand new businesses qualify for funding all the time. So we should be able to help as long as we help you get optimized correctly. Would you like to learn more about that?  Worst case - we will send you in the right direction with a ton of free trainings. Fair enough?

entries.question: Do I need tax returns?
entries.responseTemplate: That's actually not that important factor for the funding we do since we optimize your borrower profile and apply through our business bankers. So even without tax returns you could still get funding

entries.question: How to check my credit score?
entries.responseTemplate: You can go to free credit monitoring websites such as Credit Karma or Nerdwallet. You may also be able to find it on your banking app depending on the bank you use. But if you want the accurate FICO report that the banks use I recommend signing up for MyScoreIQ. I have a discount code if you want that

entries.question: "My credit is too low”
entries.responseTemplate: Yeah unfortunately you need 700+ credit to qualify for business funding.  But great thing about credit is that anything is fixable. We actually have an incredible credit program that could help you fix and remove any negative items on your credit report quickly. Would this interest you?

entries.question: Cost of the Credit Repair Clinic
entries.responseTemplate: Our Credit Repair Clinic is priced very affordable compared to the typical credit repair agencies that charge up to $2000. Our service is available for $297, and we also offer a 10 Day Money Back Guarantee. That means you can try our service with no risk to you.

entries.question: Cost of the 5KO Accelerated Repair
entries.responseTemplate: Our 5KO Accelerated Repair costs $2.5k but the goal here is paying for speed. Most credit repair can take 6-9 months which may really push back your goals. Instead with this program, we can fix your credit within 30 days.

entries.question: "Do you do credit repair + funding?”
entries.responseTemplate: Yeah, inside of our business funding accelerator we also have an accelerated credit repair strategy so we could get you optimized and ready for funding within 30 days!

entries.question: Not qualified-poor credit on application
entries.responseTemplate: I see you in the system. Unfortunately, you didn't qualify due to your credit. Have you done anything to fix it yet?

entries.question: I need funding not credit repair (low income)
entries.responseTemplate: Got it. well credit repair will be a mandatory first step to getting you funding. We focus on helping {{niche}} qualify for {{target_funding_amount}}. However, if you don't have the required credit score then I do have a credit repair course that can help you.  Our program helps you get approved for up to {{target_funding_amount}} but we do require a 700+ credit score. However, if you don't have the required credit score then I do have a credit repair course that can help you

entries.question: Do inquiries matter
entries.responseTemplate: They do matter but it is the easiest thing to fix on your report. The most important thing with your credit is having a score that is above 700. Do you fit that requirement?

entries.question: Why does the personal credit matter for biz funding
entries.responseTemplate: If you are a new business the banks need to look at the owner's personal credit history to evaluate the credit worthiness of the business. If the business is over 2 years old and has cashflow + tax returns they can evaluate the credit worthiness based on the business history but I do still recommend to have good credit

entries.question: Are you asking for personal credit or business credit?
entries.responseTemplate: Personal credit score. This is actually an important factor even for business funding.

entries.question: What's the time frame of credit repair?
entries.responseTemplate: Most items can be removed within 6-9 months but we also have an accelerated repair system that can fix your credit within 30 days

entries.question: Credit Repair Clinic program
entries.responseTemplate: Ok great. You will need to start with that Credit Repair Clinic program. Here is the link: {{asset.credit-repair-clinic}}

entries.question: 5KO Accelerated Repair program
entries.responseTemplate: Ok great. You can learn more and book a call here: {{booking_link}}

entries.question: They don't have an LLC yet
entries.responseTemplate: You would need that to get funding but it's no worries I can help you set that up. Are you currently {{qualifying_questions}}

entries.question: Business has no revenue but credit is good
entries.responseTemplate: Your personal credit is actually more important than the revenue. So you could still get funding. However we tend to only work with clients that are {{income_qualifiers}}.  If you aren't there yet, go checkout my youtube. It should be able to help

entries.question: Currently opening LLC and getting EIN
entries.responseTemplate: Ok that's solid. Yeah having an LLC makes the funding so much easier

entries.question: Do I have to pay?
entries.responseTemplate: Yes we do charge a fee for our services but our goal is to help you get funding faster and easier on your own that you can leverage to {{dream_outcome}}

entries.question: How long is the process
entries.responseTemplate: It'll depend for each client but most get funding within 45 days

entries.question: Cost of funding program?
entries.responseTemplate: The cost of our service will depend on what you need and how long we work together. It can range from a couple hundred dollars to thousands. Would you like to hop on a call to go over all this?

entries.question: What are your fees?
entries.responseTemplate: Depending on what you need we charge from a few hundred to a few thousand. Would you like to hop on a call to go over all this?

entries.question: Application link is not working
entries.responseTemplate: Could you please try a different browser or different device? We've received multiple applications today so it should be working

entries.question: "Can I call you?" / "Can we talk now?”
entries.responseTemplate: Well, we only take booked calls. I prefer to prepare for the call so that we can be most effective with your time. Here is booking link: {{booking_link}}

entries.question: Calls on the weekend
entries.responseTemplate: We don't take calls on the weekends unfortunately, but you can use this link to book whatever time works best for you once you complete the application: {{booking_link}}

entries.question: "I filled out form" - but you don't see it
entries.responseTemplate: I don't see a (their name) in the system. Going through the application is required as it will pre-qualify you for the funding. We don't want to sign you up if you wouldn't be able to benefit from our service.  The main requirements are {{requirements}}. Do you fit that?

entries.question: Complaining that application didnt approve them
entries.responseTemplate: Yeah unfortunately we only work with clients that would 100% get results so if the form didn't let you book it means that you might be missing something.  If you aren't there yet, go checkout my YouTube. It should be able to help

entries.question: Let's meet (in person)
entries.responseTemplate: if you would like to hop on a call first I'd be happy to discuss further

entries.question: Age requirement
entries.responseTemplate: The main requirement is having good credit. To have credit you need to be over 18 years old. We have ways to help you extend your credit age but you need to have a foundation already established

entries.question: Terms of the funding
entries.responseTemplate: Most of the funding we help our clients with is business credit cards. They are usually 0% interest for 12 months and you can maintain the balance as long as you want as long as you pay the minimum payment each month (about 1% of the balance)

entries.question: Needs [less than 20k] (low amount)
entries.responseTemplate: We might not be the best fit for you. We help our clients get $50k-$150k of funding and we charge high ticket for our program

entries.question: REPAYMENT TERMS (for the funding)
entries.responseTemplate: You need to make payments of 1-2% of the balance you carry / month to the bank

entries.question: Concerns they cannot pay back their bank loan
entries.responseTemplate: The goal of the funding is to grow your income. Hopefully by leveraging the funding you can make a lot more than you borrowed and then you can keep making more money since you would have grown so much

entries.question: What is maxed allowed?
entries.responseTemplate: If you are starting a new business or have been in operation for under 2 years, most of the time the max amount will be around $150k. If you have been established or have cashflow, you could qualify for much more. In some cases $500k+

entries.question: Wants personal funding
entries.responseTemplate: Got it. We actually mostly focus on business funding. Obtaining funding through your personal credit could hurt your score so I usually recommend against it. Have you considered getting funding through your business?

entries.question: Do you deal with UCC?
entries.responseTemplate: It’ll depend on the bank but if you want to get loans and business lines of credit most banks do place a UCC on your business but some banks don’t. Business credit cards never require that though.

entries.question: How long is 0%?
entries.responseTemplate: We have special banking offers that allow us to borrow the funds at 0% interest for 12-18 months.

entries.question: What's the interest after the 12-18 months 0%?
entries.responseTemplate: So the great thing is that you get to take advantage of this funding for a whole 1+ year before owing interest. So you can use it to increase income and hopefully pay it off or most of it before the interest rate starts. The interest rate does go up to standard credit card rates after that.
